nodes.exact_official_label: Statutory Certifications and Undertakings
nodes.official_instruction: Statutory execution certifications and Board undertakings prescribed in Appendix-I.

nodes.exact_official_label: Qualified Person Block Boundary Confinement Certificate
nodes.official_instruction: Qualified Person (Rule 22C MCR 1960) / MPPA mandatory undertaking: Certifies that project area is strictly confined within allocated block boundary, or furnishes required State NOC and CMPDI non-coal/technical-viability proof.

nodes.exact_official_label: Board Undertaking on Data Correctness & Statutory Adherence
nodes.official_instruction: Company Board / Authorized Signatory mandatory undertaking: Undertaking for correctness of data, acceptance of Mining Plan, adherence to Mines Act 1952, CMR 2017, EP Act 1986, FC Act 1980.

nodes.exact_official_label: Progressive & Final Mine Closure Execution Undertaking
nodes.official_instruction: Lessee / Nominated Owner mandatory undertaking: Undertaking that reclamation & rehabilitation shall follow approved closure plan; annual compliance report to CCO before 1st July; surrender of reclaimed land.

nodes.exact_official_label: Environmental Clearance (EC) & Forestry Clearance (FC) Compliance Undertaking
nodes.official_instruction: Lessee / Nominated Owner mandatory undertaking: Mandatory undertaking that mine operations shall be strictly executed in compliance with terms of EC and FC.
